turnaround_reason: Debt-laden after the $2.1B Omni acquisition (added ~$1.4B debt), Forward Air is under activist pressure and running a strategic review; the equity is effectively an option on deleveraging via asset sales.
bullish_points: Hard catalyst in play: strategic review nearing conclusion, pivoting to divestitures of Intermodal + legacy Omni assets (~$394M of 2025 revenue) to cut debt.
Activists (~25% of shares) are pushing for value-unlocking actions.
+24% over 30 days; freight cycle upturn plus asset-sale proceeds could re-rate the thin equity quickly.
Net leverage (5.5x) sits ~1 turn inside the covenant, buying some runway.
bearish_points: Full-company sale looks unlikely (no actionable proposals), which took some air out of the buyout thesis (-6% over 5 days).
Net debt ~$1.68B at 5.5x EBITDA is dangerous; small EBITDA slips move the equity violently.
TTM profit margin is negative; fwd P/E ~39 — not statistically cheap on earnings.
Freight demand is cyclical and soft; divestiture proceeds may disappoint on price.
catalyst: Conclusion of the strategic review / announced asset divestitures and debt paydown.
catalyst_timing: H2 2026 (review said to be nearing conclusion).
suggested_trade: Small speculative spot sized as an event/option; not a core position.
key_risk: Divestitures fall through or price low, leaving leverage intact into a soft freight cycle.
would_skip_if: You avoid 5x+ levered names or need positive cash earnings to underwrite.
